metaDescription: Order custom Champion shorts in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate giveaways. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Champion shorts bring instant brand recognition thanks to the iconic C logo. Whether you choose the cotton gym short for comfort or the mesh short with pockets for active use, these pieces hold up to frequent washing and heavy rotation. Screen printing or embroidery both work well on the roomy thigh and hip areas. For company picnics, team uniforms, or summer swag bags, custom Champion shorts give recipients a piece of apparel they actually want to wear.
